rationale: The breakdown below $10.38 failed to follow through, finding high-volume buying support at $10.33 and reversing sharply back above both our $10.52 entry price and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($10.53). Because a key pillar of the short thesis was price remaining suppressed below the 5-minute 9-EMA, reclaiming this level at $10.58 invalidates the immediate bearish momentum and warrants exiting before the hard stop at $10.66 is hit. Flipping to long is avoided due to overhead resistance at session VWAP ($10.71) and persistent broader market weakness.
